item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Oct 26
item.description:
11 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

Loot & Resources

  • Underwater crates now contain blueprint fragments and blueprint pages, matching other loot pools.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Oct 25
item.description:
16 development commits

Animals & AI

  • Animal repellant buff now only affects sharks (they flee) and bee swarms (they won't chase); bulls and rams ignore the buff and will neither flee nor charge.
  • Chickens on the tutorial island no longer act aggressively.

Farming

  • Sunflower seed-stage plants can now be cleared reliably with a melee weapon.
  • Child livestock can leave their mother's leash radius to eat from a trough, preventing them from getting stuck hungry in pens.

Building & UI

  • Building planner now shows the specific blocker name instead of a generic "Cannot build in this area" message.
  • Ramp placement improved: aiming at the center of a foundation now places ramps correctly.

Bug Fixes

  • Wrapping paper can no longer be filled with water, preventing unintended item behavior.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Oct 24
item.description:
10 development commits

Tools & Crafting

  • Shears now harvest 25% more wool, have double durability (200), and deal reduced damage (4 slash + 4 stab), making them a more efficient wool‑gathering tool.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Network packet batching reduces latency and improves responsiveness; can be toggled at runtime.
  • Fixed viewmodel camera bone positioning, correcting misaligned weapon view.
